features.notes: The bottom composer ("Tell Crado what you measured, changed or observed") is MVP-10's job — its own acceptance criteria are 'observation persists' / 'analysis can update evidence/hypothesis'. MVP-09's explicit scope (per the ticket instructions actually given) was the read/run/stream/reconstruct workspace, not the composer, so 'composer records observation' was dropped here and left to MVP-10 where it's the actual deliverable.

features.title: Engineering Knowledge Base (document storage, ingestion, hybrid retrieval)
acceptance: workspace-isolated document storage with real RLS, private Supabase Storage
PDF/TXT/Markdown ingestion: extract -> chunk -> embed -> store -> mark indexed, with a PDF with no extractable text marked failed (not silently indexed)
every chunk retains provenance: documentId, filename, page or section, product/revision relationship
searchEngineeringDocuments() does hybrid (keyword + semantic) retrieval via Postgres/pgvector, no separate vector DB
Documents/Sources UI: real counts only, real status (UPLOADING/PROCESSING/INDEXED/FAILED), source preview with highlighted passage
pagination and workspace/product/revision filtering verified against a 120-document programmatic dataset, not just a handful
workspace isolation verified for documents, chunks, search, and Storage (download/list/upload/delete all rejected cross-workspace, including a guessed exact path)
features.notes: The Investigation Agent (MVP-10B) and citation/source drawer (MVP-10C) are separate follow-on tickets that build on this. The 'semantic' half of retrieval is a zero-dependency local hashed lexical embedding (src/lib/documents/embedding.ts), not a neural embedding model — no embeddings API key is configured, and adding a new third-party credential is a one-way-door decision per CLAUDE.md, not made unasked. Swapping in a real embedding provider later is a drop-in change behind the same EmbeddingAdapter-shaped function signature.

features.title: Investigation Agent (ToolLoopAgent orchestration layer)
acceptance: one Investigation Agent (src/lib/agents), built on AI SDK ToolLoopAgent, with exactly six bounded tools: getProductContext, getMeasurementContext, getDeterministicCorrelations, searchEngineeringDocuments, getPreviousRevisions, getPreviousInvestigations
deterministic correlation (MVP-06) stays guaranteed and unchanged; the agent only runs after real candidates exist, and never recomputes them
structured output only (Zod, via Output.object) — hypotheses[] with reasoning/evidenceRefs/missingEvidence/nextInvestigation, clarificationQuestion, investigationStatus; no free-form prose contract

independent post-hoc validation rejects hallucinated productFactId/certainty language (whole hypothesis) and hallucinated or mismatched document/fact/investigation citations (that one citation only), reusing MVP-07's buildObservedEvidence/buildKnownEvidence/containsProhibitedCertaintyLanguage rather than reimplementing them
bounded tool loop: explicit stopWhen at 9 steps, not the SDK's 20-step default; a model that never produces a final answer fails the run cleanly rather than looping

observable, safe agent.started/agent.tool.completed/agent.completed events (tool name, safe label, result count, durationMs, query) — never hidden reasoning or a raw prompt; persisted and reconstructed exactly like existing analysis_events

truthful agent.completed metrics (documentsAvailable/documentSearches/passagesRetrieved/passagesUsedAsEvidence/deterministicRelationshipsChecked/nextInvestigationCount) computed from real tool-call results, never fabricated
fully backward compatible: createAnalysisRunForFailureCase's agentModel option and runAnalysis's agentRunner are additive/optional — every MVP-08/09 test passes unchanged with neither supplied

live-verified against a real Gateway X case (40 MHz clock, WiFi radio, unshielded display cable, one seeded test-report document, 200 MHz/+7.4dB measurement): full event sequence including 5 document searches, 2 evidence-labeled hypotheses with real document citations (filename+section+exact quoted passage) and no root-cause/certainty language, persisted rows match the stream exactly
features.notes: The polished agent-activity UI (source drawer, live tool-call panel) is MVP-10C, not built here — this ticket is the orchestration layer and its backend event/reducer foundation only. The live test uncovered and fixed two real defects: reasoning/nextInvestigation needed wider Zod bounds (600/300 -> 1200/500 chars) for the agent's evidence-integrated answers, and the tool-activity label pluralizer was naively appending 's' to two-word nouns ('passage retrieveds') — fixed to pluralize the noun only ('passages retrieved'), covered by a regression test.

Agent Activity renders only persisted agent.started/agent.tool.completed/agent.completed events as observable work (e.g. 'Loaded product context / 3 structured facts'); no chain-of-thought/reasoning language anywhere
live run shows tool events appearing progressively with a pulsing 'Working…' status, no fake typing animation; verified against a real live (non-replayed) Anthropic run in-browser

'What Crado handled' grid shows real execution metrics (documentsAvailable/documentSearches/passagesRetrieved/passagesUsedAsEvidence/deterministicRelationshipsChecked/nextInvestigationCount) from agent.completed, never hardcoded

every document-backed KNOWN evidence item carries a structured citation (documentId/chunkId/filename/documentType/pageNumber/section/passage) built only from the stored retrieval registry, never model-generated text; citation is a clickable badge

source drawer shows filename/type/revision, page or section, the exact stored passage, 'Used in' (hypothesis) and 'Evidence type'; accessible dialog with focus capture/restore, Tab trap, Escape-to-close, backdrop click — verified in a real browser, not just jsdom

Sources panel lists documents actually used with per-document passage-used counts and a link to /documents; honest empty states for 'no passages retrieved' vs 'passages retrieved but none used as evidence', verified live (a real run legitimately hit 0-passages-retrieved)

hypothesis cards show 'HYPOTHESIS 0N' numbering, four visually separated evidence classes, a deterministic-relationship block visually distinct from AI inference, and a 'Why this test' line beside Next Investigation

/documents polished into a 'SOURCES' repository: real unfiltered total count, All/Product/Testing/Regulatory/Datasheets/Notes filter tabs (filtering never shrinks the header count), filename/type/product+revision/status/indexed-date rows

mobile order is Product, Measurement, Investigation (hypotheses incl. Next Investigation), Agent Activity, What Crado Handled, Sources — achieved via a single responsive grid with per-breakpoint order classes, no duplicated markup; source drawer becomes a full-screen sheet
refresh reconstructs all agent activity/metrics/hypotheses/sources from persisted analysis_events, never reruns the agent
features.notes: Investigation Agent architecture (MVP-10B) untouched except one additive, backward-compatible change: an optional structured `citation` field on evidenceItem (schema.ts) plus buildDocumentPassageEvidence returning it alongside the existing text description — justified as the one genuine UI-exposed gap (citations existed only as unstructured text). Visual QA done live via chrome-devtools MCP: desktop, tablet (834px, collapses to a sensible 2-column), and mobile screenshots; keyboard tab-order and drawer focus-trap/Escape confirmed in a real browser; one real live Anthropic run observed end-to-end (button click -> 'Investigation complete' in ~47s, 3 hypotheses, 5 document searches that legitimately returned 0 passages this run, confirming the 'no relevant passages retrieved' empty state is real behavior, not just a fixture). Observed but out of scope to fix here: the live model occasionally duplicates a KNOWN evidence line (e.g. 'Product context: system clock — 40 MHz' twice in one hypothesis) — a model-output quality issue, not a UI defect, worth a future prompt tightening pass.

features.title: Observation updates hypothesis
acceptance: a structured 'Record result' action (Observation / Measurement change if known / Operating mode / Notes — never a chatbot textarea) persists an engineer observation as a real investigation_events row, workspace-isolated by RLS
an engineer-entered observation is classified OBSERVED evidence in the next investigation run, distinguishable from KNOWN/INFERRED/MISSING — verified both by unit test and a real live Anthropic run

the model can never silently promote the observation's text into a new KNOWN/OBSERVED claim beyond what was entered: OBSERVED/KNOWN evidence stays assembled deterministically from stored rows, exactly like MVP-07/MVP-10B's existing structural guarantee

the Investigation Agent can inspect prior hypotheses from earlier completed runs of the same case (new getPreviousHypotheses tool) alongside the new observation (existing getPreviousInvestigations tool) and, only when it judges one continues an earlier hypothesis, tags it with a qualitative-only status: supported_by_new_evidence / weakened_by_new_evidence / unchanged / needs_more_evidence — no Bayesian/probability claim implemented or exposed

the previous hypothesis is never rewritten or deleted — a chronological investigation timeline (measurement -> hypothesis -> observation -> updated investigation) proves old and updated hypotheses both remain visible and auditable
refresh reconstructs the observation, updated hypothesis status, and full timeline from persisted rows alone, without rerunning the model
duplicate submission of the observation form is prevented
